description: Server-side rendering logic for booking and event pages, including rescheduling, seating, and user-specific event data fetching.

methods.name: processReschedule
methods.description: Handles rescheduling logic, including validation and potential redirects based on booking status and event type.

methods.name: processSeatedEvent
methods.description: Handles seated event bookings, including validation and redirects for canceled bookings.

methods.name: getDynamicGroupPageProps
methods.description: Fetches and prepares props for dynamic group event pages, including user and event data, and handles redirects.

methods.name: getUserPageProps
methods.description: Fetches and prepares props for individual user event pages, including user and event data, and handles redirects.
